lines.zh: 我张开翼膜，滑了一小段。
lines.en: I spread my membrane and glide a short way.
I hop between branches.
My tail is long and trails behind.
I glide from the tree onto your shoulder.
Every two steps, I hop.
I climb the rough bark.
I leap to another branch.

lines.zh: 我从枝上跳下，落在草叶上。
lines.en: I drop from the branch onto the grass.
I walk along the top of the wall.
My tail keeps me balanced.
I look down from up high.
I climb back into the tree hollow.
I doze upside down on my hind claws.
I tuck my body into my wings.

lines.zh: 周围每一声响，我的耳朵都转过去。
lines.en: My ears turn toward every little sound.
This tree smells good.
I doze, hanging from the branch.
I stretch my forepaws out.

lines.zh: 我挂在细枝上，跟着风摆。
lines.en: I hang from a twig and sway with the wind.
I'm counting the fruit on the tree.
My nest is over there.
I'd like something sweet.
Lend me your shoulder.
I've landed on your head.
Your hat is easy to grip.

lines.zh: 我趴在枝上，正好在你头顶。
lines.en: I lie on the branch right above your head.
Can you see me if you look up?
I'll glide down for you to see.
I'm small; don't swat.

lines.zh: 我会做农夫，也会做剑士。
lines.en: I can farm, and I can fight.

lines.zh: 你慢些，我的翼膜快追不上。
lines.en: Slow down; my wing membrane can't keep up.

lines.zh: 我在枝上跟着你，走一段。
lines.en: I follow you along the branches for a while.

lines.zh: 我用爪子勾住你的袖口。
lines.en: I hook a claw into your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我在你背后的那根枝上。
lines.en: I'm on the branch behind you.
Let's climb the tree together.
Your hair is a bit long.
I hop onto the back of your hand.
Don't shake; I can't hold on.
I tuck my tail under myself.
I drop a little way from the branch.
I catch the trunk.
My membrane is torn.
My tail is trembling.
I climb to a higher branch.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，只发出一点气声。
lines.en: I curl up and let out only a breath of sound.

lines.zh: 我钻进叶子底下，尾巴还在抖。
lines.en: I burrow under a leaf, tail still trembling.
My hind legs can still push.
I'll come down later.
There's a little sweetness here.
Let me try a little first.
I hold it in both paws.
This is better than tree fruit.
Is there another one?

lines.zh: 我捧着果子，眼睛还在乱转。
lines.en: I cup the fruit and keep glancing around.

lines.zh: 我塞进嘴里，腮帮子鼓了。
lines.en: I stuff it in, cheeks bulging.
I'll hide this to eat slowly.
Once I've eaten, I'll follow you.
This is sweet — thank you.
You nearly knocked me off.
I grip the branch.
I land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 两只飞鼠在半空撞成一团。
lines.en: Two flying squirrels collide midair.
I flipped and recovered.
My membrane creased.
I leap away onto the tree.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的肩，弹回枝上。
lines.en: I hit your shoulder and bounce back to the branch.
I didn't fall this time.

lines.zh: 我甩甩尾巴，挪到另一根枝。
lines.en: I flick my tail and move to another branch.
The one in the tree is still asleep.
Its membrane is wider than mine.
We circle the same branch.
It leaps over, I leap back.
We slip into the hollow together.
The hollow is warm and dry.

lines.zh: 我们挤在树洞里，毛贴着毛。
lines.en: We squeeze into the hole, fur against fur.
The wind is strong outside.

lines.zh: 树洞里只剩我们的呼吸声。
lines.en: Only our breathing remains in the hollow.
We'll go out at dawn.
I hug it with my claws.
Too heavy; it'll fall.

lines.zh: 我抱着它，从树上溜下来。
lines.en: I carry it down from the tree.
I dropped it on the way down.
I stuff it into the hollow.

lines.zh: 我用两只前爪也抱不住它。
lines.en: Even both forepaws can't hold it.
I carry it to the branch's end.
This can go in the hollow.
Two paws aren't enough.
I leave it under the tree.
The fallen leaves shifted below.
I lean out from the branch.
Position noted. Behind the tree.
I lie flat on the branch.

lines.zh: 它卡在树干和枝杈中间。
lines.en: It is wedged between trunk and fork.

lines.zh: 我顺着树干，一点一点滑下去。
lines.en: I slide down the trunk a little at a time.
I shrink into the leaf's shadow.
My tail hooks the branch.
It's one block below me.
This one has to be precise.

lines.zh: 我从树洞里探出两只爪子。
lines.en: I poke both paws out of the tree hole.
My skin flaps let me glide a while.
I follow it from the branches.
A little closer.
I'm hanging above it.
My tail hooks the branch.
My tail swings once.
It glanced up at the tree.
I hang motionless on the branch.
It lowered its head again.
I let go with my tail.
I spread my membrane and glide down.
The wind pushed me off course.
I adjust my angle.

lines.zh: 我挂在它头顶，尾巴勾着树枝。
lines.en: I hang above its head, tail hooked on the branch.
I slide down the trunk.
I must grip properly.
It started running. I'm following.
I'm quicker than it through the branches.
I land on its shoulder.
I scratch its ear.
I bite its hem.

lines.zh: 它猛地回头，我缩回枝上。
lines.en: It whips around; I shrink back onto the branch.
I land one hit and leap away.
My claws only broke the skin.
I pounce again.
I got thrown off.
I flip over and land.
It ran off into the trees.
I hop back into the tree.
I catch my breath on the branch.
I swing across on my tail.
I kick it with my hind feet.
I bite once and let go.
I climb back up high.

lines.zh: 我头朝下，从树洞口爬出来。
lines.en: Headfirst, I crawl out of the tree hole.
I spread my membrane to dry.
There are plenty of trees here.
First I climb higher.
I can see you below.

lines.zh: 我从洞口探出半个身子。
lines.en: I poke half my body out of the hole.
The wind is right; I can glide far.
I head for another tree.
There's fruit here.
I put my head out and look.
My nest is right here.
I start hopping between branches.
One lick of fire and my membrane curls.

lines.zh: 我从树上摔下来，摔得发懵。
lines.en: I fall from the tree and I'm dazed.

lines.zh: 水把我按住，我拼命挣扎。
lines.en: Water pins me and I thrash.

lines.zh: 冲击把我从枝上掀下来。
lines.en: The blast blows me off the branch.

lines.zh: 有根箭穿过我旁边的叶子。
lines.en: An arrow passes through the leaves beside me.

lines.zh: 那道光刺得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The light stings my eyes shut.
Too hungry to hop.
At the thunder I dive into the hollow.

lines.zh: 没有树也没有地，我一路掉。
lines.en: No trees, no ground; I keep falling.
